checks.text: Typing Read in Habit name and clicking Add habit shows a list item with the text Read and the text Streak: 0, and seven unticked checkboxes from "Read, 6 days ago" to "Read, Today".
Clicking Add habit with Habit name empty, and again with Habit name holding three spaces, shows the text "Enter a habit name." and the Habits list stays empty.
After adding Read, typing Read in Habit name and clicking Add habit shows the text "That habit already exists." and the Habits list still has exactly one item.
After adding Read, clicking the checkbox "Read, Today" makes it checked, shows ✓ inside it, and shows Streak: 1; clicking it again makes it unchecked and shows Streak: 0.
After adding Read, ticking "Read, 3 days ago", "Read, 2 days ago" and "Read, 1 day ago" shows Streak: 3; then ticking "Read, Today" shows Streak: 4.
After adding Read, ticking only "Read, 3 days ago" and "Read, 2 days ago" (1 day ago and Today left unticked) shows Streak: 0.

After adding Read and ticking "Read, Today", clicking Rename Read shows a text box labelled "New name for Read" holding Read; replacing its text with Read daily and pressing Enter shows a list item with the text Read daily, no list item with the exact name Read, and the checkbox "Read daily, Today" checked.
After adding Read, clicking Delete Read opens a dialog with the text "Delete Read?"; pressing Escape closes the dialog and the list item Read is still shown.
After adding Read, clicking Delete Read and then Confirm delete in the dialog closes the dialog and the Habits list has no items.
Reload keeps habits and ticks: after adding Read and ticking "Read, Today", reloading the page shows the list item Read with "Read, Today" checked and the text Streak: 1.
